nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Last summer, my friend Tom and I went to the coast for a long weekend.
We planned everything carefully.
Or that's what we thought.
On Friday, we got up at five o'clock and took a taxi to the train station.
But when we arrived, we saw a sign on the door: no trains today.
There was a problem with the tracks.
So we took a bus.
The bus was slow and very hot, and the trip took seven hours, not three.
When we finally arrived, it was dark, and we couldn't find our hotel.
We walked around the town for an hour with our heavy bags.
At last, a kind woman showed us the way.
At the hotel, the receptionist looked at her computer and said, "I'm sorry, but there's no reservation for you."
Tom made the reservation, but he chose the wrong month!
There weren't any free rooms, so we slept in a tiny room above a noisy bar.
On Saturday, it rained all day.
We didn't swim, and we didn't see the sun.
We spent the afternoon in a café and played cards.
On Sunday, the sky was blue at last, and we went to the beach.
Tom fell asleep in the sun and didn't wake up for two hours.
He got very red, and he couldn't sleep that night.
Was it a bad trip?
Yes, it was terrible!
But now, when we remember it, we laugh a lot.
It's our favorite story.
